rollback_contract.first_probe: Real Apply uses unchanged RunOperation/RunTransaction and commits once on a fresh owned DB; preserve actual commit timing and persisted assertions. Keep the DB for evidence rather than fake Commit into Rollback.

rollback_contract.later_plan_probe: If EXPLAIN ANALYZE of write SQL is needed, use a separate fresh owned transaction and rollback at the end; compare logical source/target/issue/participation/event/snapshot fingerprints. Do not assert rollback restored WAL/buffers/tuple versions/statistics.
rollback_contract.global_prohibition: No shared cluster configuration/index changes, source DB reuse, forced disconnect or speculative cleanup.
